keyPointsEn: After 4 consecutive days of decline, a 24.13% rebound today attempts a bounce after testing short-term lows.
The rally lost momentum, hitting resistance at SMA20 ($1,896,550), maintaining weak convergence.
RSI is sideways around 40, and subdued volume lowers confidence in a trend reversal, thus maintaining a wait-and-see approach.

analysis.continuityEn: 4-day streak of 'watchful waiting'. Similar to the previous record, RSI entered oversold territory and is now maintaining a neutral zone, with MACD weak convergence continuing.
